title: In-Q-Tel portfolio & CIA/IC-venture surveillance-&-data-stack lineage
source: Public record: In-Q-Tel disclosed portfolio/history; corporate acquisition records (Google/Keyhole 2004; Google/Mandiant 2022); press. Structural overlay; edges graded in notes. Surveillance-cluster webbing (#218). In-Q-Tel->Palantir is carried in spec-palantir-surveillance.json (not duplicated here).

edges.notes: In-Q-Tel funded Keyhole Inc. (~2003), the geospatial-imaging startup (fact).
In-Q-Tel was an early investor in Recorded Future (threat-intel / OSINT analytics) (fact).
In-Q-Tel was an early investor in FireEye (later Mandiant) (fact).
Google acquired Keyhole in 2004; its tech became Google Earth / Maps (fact).
Google acquired Mandiant in 2022 (~$5.4B), folding it into Google Cloud security (fact).
IQT seed investment in Palantir (~2004-2005); the CIA was Palantir's primary early customer for years - the flagship IQT surveillance/data-fusion bet (fact of relationship; amounts undisclosed).
IQT invested in Databricks (~2016), the lakehouse/AI data-platform (later ~$43B valuation) - data-fusion substrate for IC analytics (fact of relationship; confirmed via IQT team page).
IQT-backed big-data (Hadoop) platform - one of IQT's billion-dollar outcomes; enterprise/IC data lakes (fact).
IQT invested in 10gen/MongoDB - document database widely used across gov data systems (fact; an IQT 'unicorn' exit).

IQT relationship with Anduril (defense autonomy/sensing/counter-UAS; Luckey/Founders-Fund lineage) - ties the IQT web to the Palantir/Thiel defense cluster (fact of IQT relationship per IQT leadership; deal terms undisclosed).
IQT-backed synthetic-biology platform - the biosecurity/biodata leg of the IQT portfolio (fact; IQT lists it among notable outcomes).
Palantir<->Databricks product partnership (Foundry/AIP + lakehouse interop) - two IQT-lineage data platforms interoperating (fact).

note: In-Q-Tel (IQT) is the CIA/Intelligence-Community's not-for-profit strategic investor (est. 1999); it does NOT disclose funding amounts/dates, so edges are graded on the PUBLIC record of an IQT relationship, not on deal terms. IQT reports ~494 portfolio companies (Aug 2026). Edges are STRUCTURAL (cia_seed / corporate_lineage) - an IQT tie is a capability/adoption signal, NOT evidence of witting espionage by the company.
